info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Special Pricing Conditions API
info.description: The Special Pricing Conditions API facilitates access to specialized pricing rules and conditions for banking products. This API allows users to retrieve current pricing conditions that may apply due to specific business scenarios or customer agreements. Typical consumers include financial analysts, product managers, and developers looking to enhance pricing strategies. By leveraging this API, organizations can ensure competitive pricing and tailored offerings based on market demands.

get.summary: Retrieve special pricing conditions for products
get.description: This endpoint allows users to fetch the special pricing conditions that are applicable to various products. It returns the relevant details to help users understand the pricing rules and any exceptions that may apply.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to specify special pricing conditions for products. It allows the client to define various parameters that will influence the retrieval of special pricing information.

GetSpecialPricingConditionsRequest.description: A representation of the request body for the special pricing conditions operation in the product management context.

items.description: A list of product items with special pricing conditions.

sort.description: Sorting parameter used in the API request.

GetSpecialPricingConditionsResponse_200.description: Response schema for the special pricing conditions in the product management API.

customerSegment.description: Segment of customers that the pricing condition applies to.

baseCurrency.description: Currency in which the pricing is set.

effectiveDate.description: Date when the pricing condition becomes effective.

recordStatus.description: Current status of the product record.

updatedAt.description: Timestamp of the last update to the product item.

ProductItem.description: Details of a product with special pricing.

page.description: Current page number in the paginated response.

totalItems.description: Total number of items available across all pages.
